description: Commitment boundary: emit a provisional statement for agent-to-agent negotiation. Default is non-binding until a PromotionEvent satisfies a PromotionPolicy. Dead-man expiry auto-withdraws.

author.description: AgentDID/public key of the emitting agent

author_private_key.description: Hex private key of author for signing

dead_man_ms.description: Dead-man expiry relative to now (ms). If elapsed without promotion/withdrawal, statement auto-withdraws.

name: aps_create_provisional
